name: Veal Or Mutton Broth
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: an ounce of pearl barley or rice
ingredients.originalText: an ounce of pearl barley or rice
ingredients.quantityText: an ounce of pearl barley or rice

instructions.text: Put scrag-end of mutton in a saucepan, with two quarts of cold water, and an ounce of pearl barley or rice
When it is coming to a boil, skim it well
Then add half a teaspoonful of salt
Let it boil until half reduced, then strain it, and take off all the fat
If vegetables are liked in this broth, cut turnip, carrot, and onion in shreds, and boil them in the broth half an hour
The barley may be served with the vegetables in broth

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put scrag-end of mutton in a saucepan, with two quarts of cold water, and an ounce of pearl barley or rice
2. When it is coming to a boil, skim it well
3. Then add half a teaspoonful of salt
4. Let it boil until half reduced, then strain it, and take off all the fat
5. If vegetables are liked in this broth, cut turnip, carrot, and onion in shreds, and boil them in the broth half an hour
6. The barley may be served with the vegetables in broth
